data.camera: medium shot, shallow depth of field
data.description: 【调月莉音 · 绝密档案馆深思】千年中央绝密档案馆幽暗的书架前，莉音靠在金属隔板旁翻阅着古老的记录晶片，手腕上的银色腕表折射着冷光。她低声自语——「世人都以为我冷酷自负……但为了保护所有人，即便成为大家口中的‘大笨蛋’，我也必须做那个背负一切的观测者。」
data.promptProse: Rio leans beside a metal archive divider and examines an old record chip, her thoughtful gaze lowered above the silver watch at her wrist. Her Seminar sweater and pleated skirt remain in medium view, with shelves narrowing into the darker central archive behind. Recessed ceiling lights pick out the chip edges and watch glass, separating her black hair from the metal while deeper shelving stays quietly shaded.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 绝密档案馆深思
